wiki_only_topics.topic: Bronze Age Cycladic Culture and Ancient Greek Archaic Period
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: It was an important centre during the Bronze Age Cycladic Culture and in the Ancient Greek Archaic Period.

wiki_only_topics.topic: emery as a source of corundum abrasive
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: The island is famous as a source of emery, a rock rich in corundum, which until modern times was one of the best abrasives available.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Greek mythology involving Zeus, Ariadne, and Dionysus
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: According to Greek mythology, the young Zeus was raised in a cave on Mt. Zas (" Zas " meaning " Zeus ").

wiki_only_topics.topic: Middle Paleolithic Neanderthal activity and dwarf elephant species
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: Stelida quarry, south-west of Chora, contains Mousterian tools dating back to the Middle Paleolithic era, which indicates that Neanderthal activity on the island spanned almost 200,000 years ago.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Venetian Duchy of Naxos and Ottoman rule
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: Naxos became the seat of Sanudo's realm, known as the "Duchy of Naxos" or "Duchy of the Archipelago".
